about: Synthetic multi-turn conversations for scripts/converse-eval.mjs. Every name, fact, document and result here is invented. The assistant lines under offline are scripted stand-ins so the context can be checked without a model; they are never reported as model output. heldout variants were written before the fix and were not used to write it. Round 2 (depth) adds turns of kind event: something Helper wrote on its own (a background or scheduled result) arriving between his messages, from a fixture.
